segments.sn47.30:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena mānadinno gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
segments.sn47.30:1.3: Atha kho mānadinno gahapati aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi –
segments.sn47.30:1.4: “ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa … pe … na me, bhante, khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ.
segments.sn47.30:1.5: Bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti; abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamoti.
segments.sn47.30:1.6: Evarūpāya cāhaṃ, bhante, dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno kāye kāyānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ;
segments.sn47.30:1.7: vedanāsu … pe … citte … pe … dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
segments.sn47.30:1.10: Yāni cimāni, bhante, bhagavatā pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni desitāni, nāhaṃ, bhante, tesaṃ kiñci attani appahīnaṃ samanupassāmī”ti.
segments.sn47.30:2.3: Samattaṃ loko sirivaḍḍho, mānadinnena te dasāti.
